name: Knitting
description: Knitting word search puzzles gather yarn and needle English for adults and seniors — stitch, purl, scarf, garter, circular and quiet craft words — without yarn-brand names. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just the calm vocabulary of evening projects. Short tools such as hook, row and rib keep beginners moving; longer anchors like stockinette, circular and pattern steady the hard grid. Pair this theme with Sewing, Quilting and Reading for lamp-side company after the next row. Prefer bigger type after a long project? Choose large print. New solvers can read how to play, then cast on with an easy grid.
